# Logger { #ambdes.Logger }

```python
Logger(config)
```

Provides log of events as the simulation runs.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                   |
|----------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------|
| log_to_console | bool   | Whether to print log messages to the console. |
| log_to_file    | bool   | Whether to save log to a file.                |
| file_path      | str    | Path to save log to file.                     |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [log](#ambdes.Logger.log) | Log a message if logging is enabled. |

### log { #ambdes.Logger.log }

```python
Logger.log(msg, patient=None, sim_time=None)
```

Log a message if logging is enabled.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type          | Description                                                  | Default    |
|----------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| msg      | str           | Message to log.                                              | _required_ |
| patient  | Patient       | Patient whom the log message is about.                       | `None`     |
| sim_time | float or None | Current simulation time. If provided, prints before message. | `None`     |
